This particular config is listed at $6,330, so today’s deal takes a massive $1,550 off and marks the lowest price we’ve tracked for it so far. You’re looking at some serious value here in the current market, especially with select standalone 32GB RTX 5090 graphics cards now fetching around $4,700 on their own. Also, Best Buy currently lists the same Alienware Area-51 desktop with the less powerful RTX 5080 for over $6,000, making Dell’s deal on this RTX 5090 variant a pretty good value if you’re in the market to buy a high-end PC.
